about.en: SpaceX xStock (SPCXx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on Space Exploration Technologies Corp. shares (SPCX) issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by SPCX shares held with regulated custodians and tracks the share price on-chain; it is offered to non-US investors and carries a legal claim to the value of the underlying stock. It is the SPL token Xs3oZwbHvqis4NYcf4YKWmEia2eC84wSiVrcYcTqpH8 on Solana and the ERC-20 at 0x68FA48b1C2fe52b3D776e1953E0e782B5044ce28 on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and other networks.
